nodes.label: No Standard Math Module Rule
nodes.rationale: Using Python's built-in math module is prohibited, unless strictly necessary for an algorithm whose internal implementation in Math/ has not yet been built.

nodes.label: Internal Imports First Principle
nodes.rationale: Always import internal custom implementations from the Math/ directory whenever available.

nodes.label: Strict Test Verification Rule
nodes.rationale: After making any code changes or adding new math modules, always run pytest to ensure 100% test suite pass rate.

nodes.label: Number One Principle
nodes.rationale: Usage of the math module is not allowed, unless it is necessary for the implementation of the algorithm, and that section has not been implemented yet. Import internally wherever possible.

nodes.label: Newton-Raphson method
nodes.rationale: Implemented Newton-Raphson method for polishing roots calculated using float exponentiation. Newton-Raphson corrects fractional exponent floating point approximation issues to reach full precision.

nodes.label: Precision Modes
nodes.rationale: Supported float calculations and arbitrary precision Decimal calculations using Python's decimal library.
